cases.title: Control converts client-tool uploads to the fleet format
cases.when: A client-tool .tgpkg is uploaded and enabled
then: Devices receive the RS256 FleetPackageDocument and OCI image; no zip reaches the device

cases.title: Client-tool packages keep release-1 client limits
cases.when: A client-tool package has 33 tools, and a tool with 64 KiB + 1 input

cases.title: Check-in values come from env and are validated
cases.when: Control starts with check-in 26000 ms and 0% jitter, then with valid values
then: Refuses to start when check-in + jitter + 5 s exceeds 30 s
Valid values are served as nextIntervalMs

cases.title: A socket drop is DEGRADED, not unavailable
cases.when: The WebSocket drops while a non-idempotent job is leased
then: DEGRADED; the job is never rescheduled and ends OUTCOME_UNKNOWN at lease expiry

cases.title: Settings PATCH uses merge-patch with If-Match
cases.when: A PATCH with a stale revision, and one without Idempotency-Key

cases.title: A corrupt permission delta falls back to a snapshot
cases.when: A delta arrives with the wrong base revision, and another whose result digest does not match
then: The client rejects both and requests a full snapshot
